note: widthOffset = --window-size width minus the page's reported innerWidth. Measured with smoke.py --calibrate (neutral first probe, then a verification launch per width); it differs per browser family and clamps below about 500 px, so the runner always re-checks the reported innerWidth and FAILs on a mismatch.

provisional.thresholds.nonBgFloor: measured at M6 on real synthetic atlases: 3D and 4D scenes give nonBgRatio 0.017 to 0.089 (lowest: the 4D stage of a reference-scale case), the stub 0.125, blank canvases 0.0; the floor stays 0.0005, 34x below the lowest real scene.
provisional.thresholds.sceneOccupancyMin: calibrated at M6 on synthetic atlases (3D tab, innerWidth 1024, 1366, 1600; a part counts with its projected radius): 0.603 to 0.624 (40 parts), 0.762 to 0.768 (reference scale, 144 parts drawn), 0.829 to 0.835 (400 parts); in Node over every probe model at every level the lowest is 0.251 (one part) and 0.150 for a model trimmed to one part; the sparse-scene fixture is 0.0005. 0.1 is 6x below the lowest synthetic atlas view (the 2x margin needs at most 0.33) and 200x above the fixture. Re-measure on a real project before trusting it for atlases with very uneven rooms.
provisional.gl.rendererSubstring: measured on Edge 152 and Chrome 156 with the three SwiftShader flags; a build that no longer reports it FAILs with RENDERER until re-calibrated.
